Package it.polimi.ingsw.am54.gui.managers

package it.polimi.ingsw.am54.gui.managers
GUI support managers: encapsulate complex portions of the game board (player dashboard, card market, totem animations, and rendering) to lighten the FXML controllers.

    DashboardManager
    Manager responsible for updating and rendering the player's personal dashboard and the opponents' views in the GUI.
